name: Minds 5: mean load against the patch's mean distance
description: The cumulative mean load delivered home since tick 0 (mean_load: Σdelivered ÷ Σdeliveries; window_mean, ticks 900–1000, near the run's end) on central-near's world (5 agents, marginal-value rule, carrying limit 320) against the patches' distance from home: 4, 8, 12, 16, 20 or 24 columns, set through the home block's column (placement.x = 45 minus the distance; central-near itself is distance 8, central-far distance 20). Distance is a placement property, not a config scalar, so the x axis sets placement.x directly rather than a distance field. Seeds 1–20.
